scope__dental_hygienist_supervision_leve.quote: "Direct supervision" means that a dentist complies with all of the following: (i) Designates a patient of record upon whom the procedures are to be performed and describes the procedures to be performed. (ii) Examines the patient before prescribing the procedures to be performed and upon completion of the procedures. (iii) Is physically present in the office at the time the procedures are being performed.

"General supervision" means that a dentist complies with all of the following: (i) Designates a patient of record upon whom services are to be performed. (ii) Is physically present in the office at the time the procedures are being performed.
